sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Release tracklist: every empty "Recording of work" cell shows a 💡. Click it, or ▶💡 in the column header for all of them, and the script suggests the work with the closest title among the works of the track's artists, in orange and marked "suggested:", with "exact title" or "≈ N % alike" and a ➕ relate link to the recording's edit page. Each artist's work list is loaded once and kept for 30 days, shared with the artist Recordings page's suggestions. Nothing loads until you click, and a suggestion is not a link: the track keeps its "no associated work" flag. The column's 📊 gets a "Recording of work - Suggestions" section. New setting: "Suggest a work for tracks whose recording has none" (on).
